CRWR 200.title: Introduction to Creative Writing
CRWR 200.description: Techniques of and practice in multiple genres of writing, including fiction, poetry, creative nonfiction, screenplay, stageplay, graphic forms, lyric forms, children's literature, and writing for new media. Manuscript submission is not required for admission.

CRWR 201.title: Introduction to Writing Poetry
CRWR 201.description: An exploration of and practice in the writing of poetry, focusing on how a writer employs the technical elements of the craft of poetry. Manuscript submission not required for admission.

CRWR 203.title: Introduction to Writing for Children and Young Adults
CRWR 203.description: Techniques of and practice in creating, developing and writing for children and young adults. Manuscript submission is not required for admission.

CRWR 205.title: Introduction to Writing Creative Nonfiction
CRWR 205.description: An exploration of and practice in the writing of creative nonfiction, focusing on how a writer employs the technical elements of the craft of creative nonfiction. Manuscript submission not required for admission.

CRWR 206.title: Introduction to Writing for the Screen
CRWR 206.description: Techniques of and practice in creating, developing, and writing a screenplay. Manuscript submission is not required for admission.

CRWR 208.title: Introduction to Writing for Graphic Forms
CRWR 208.description: Techniques of and practice in creating, developing, and writing the graphic novel, manga, and other forms of illustrated writing. The ability to draw is not required. Manuscript submission is not required for admission.

CRWR 209.title: Introduction to Writing Fiction
CRWR 209.description: An exploration of the writing of fiction, focusing on how a writer employs the technical elements of the craft of fiction. Manuscript submission not required for admission.

CRWR 210.title: Introduction to Video Game Writing
CRWR 210.description: A practical, project-based class for the creation of indie-scale, story-driven video games.

CRWR 213.title: Introduction to Writing for the New Media
CRWR 213.description: An exploration of and practice in writing for new media, including podcasting, blogging, and writing for websites, games, and online environments. Manuscript submission is not required for admission.

CRWR 216.title: Short Screenplay Workshop
CRWR 216.description: Restricted to B.F.A. Film Production students.

CRWR 220.title: Introduction to Creative Writing with an Indigenous Focus
CRWR 220.description: Covers three genres from fiction, poetry, creative nonfiction, radio drama, radio feature, or stageplay.

CRWR 230.title: Introduction to Writing for Comedic Forms
CRWR 230.description: An examination of and practice in creative writing in comedic forms, including stand-up, sketch, film, new media, and text. Manuscript submission not required for admission.

CRWR 301.title: Intermediate Writing Poetry
CRWR 301.description: The writing of poetry in various forms using a combination of workshopping and online modules. Manuscript submission not required for admission.

CRWR 302.title: Writing for Podcast
CRWR 302.description: Exploration of and practice in writing for podcast.

CRWR 303.title: Intermediate Writing for Children and Young Adults
CRWR 303.description: The writing of work for children and young adults in various forms using a combination of workshopping and online modules. Manuscript submission not required for admission.

CRWR 305.title: Intermediate Writing of Creative Nonfiction
CRWR 305.description: An exploration of and practice in the writing of creative non-fiction, covering four of the more basic forms of this genre: memoir, profile, commentary, and exposition. Manuscript submission is not required for admission.

CRWR 306.title: Intermediate Writing for the Screen
CRWR 306.description: An exploration of and practice in writing for the screen, focusing on how a writer employs the technical elements of the craft of screenwriting. Manuscript submission is not required for admission.

CRWR 307.title: Intermediate Writing for the Stage
CRWR 307.description: An exploration of practice in the writing of the one-act stage play, focusing on how a writer employs the technical elements of the craft of this genre. Manuscript submission is not required for admission.

CRWR 308.title: Intermediate Writing for Graphic Forms
CRWR 308.description: The writing of graphica (comics, manga and graphic novels), using a combination of workshopping and online modules. Manuscript submission not required for admission.

CRWR 309.title: Intermediate Writing Fiction
CRWR 309.description: An exploration of the writing of fiction, focusing on how a writer employs the technical elements of the craft of fiction. Manuscript submission not required for admission.

CRWR 310.title: Intermediate Video Game Writing
CRWR 310.description: Narrative design and writing for video games.

CRWR 311.title: Intermediate Writing for Lyric Forms
CRWR 311.description: Techniques of and practice in writing for lyric forms, including song lyrics, lyrical narratives, and libretti. Manuscript submission is not required for admission.

CRWR 312.description: Origin, theory and practice of interactive story forms. Exploring structural links between interactive theatre, gaming, and extended (virtual, mixed, and augmented) reality.
